_about: Fabricated multimodal memories (owner: no real data needed). Each memory has text, an image and a spoken note that adds something new. Questions target one part each: text, image_only (only visible in the image) or audio_only (only said in the note). Images are captioned from viewing them; the spoken notes are generated by Windows' voice. The 30 text memories in embedder_probe.json are distractors.
